question.text: Which of the following is/are always false?

options.text: A quadratic equation with rational coefficients hes zero or two irrational roots
A quadratic equation with real coefficients has zero or two non-real roots
A quadratic equation with irrational coeflicients has zero or two irrational roots
A quadratic equation with integer coefficients has zero or two irrational roots

solution.text:
If a quadratic equation has irrational coefficients, then roots are also inational.
So, option (c) is always false.
